arm.notes: arm64/UEFI base (LineageOS 23.2), rooted matched pair. Ships NO game: every Roblox build is an offset overlay of the pristine /data. Images live in the arch subfolder images_dir/arm/. The pre-rooted lineage (base_arm.qcow2 v1, base_arm_v2.qcow2, base_arm_system*.qcow2) is no longer opened at boot -- the rooted system/data pair is standalone -- so base_disk was dropped and those files were archived out of images_dir (2026-08-12). [rooted]

changelog.1: pristine LineageOS 23.2 arm64 (jqssun virtio) + kiosk/device-owner provisioned pair
changelog.2: v1 + Omni loading screen (product/media), silent boot (quiet/loglevel=0), GRUB menu hidden (no LineageOS logo/countdown), androidboot.insecure_adb=1 (adb reachable on a fresh boot - without it every new account stalls on 'Allow USB debugging?'), and Roblox pre-installed as a system app in /product/app/Roblox with its arm64 native libs (2026-07-17)
changelog.3: v2 + persist.sys.zram_enabled=1 baked into /product/etc/build.prop, which turns on the zram swap the image already declares in /vendor/etc/fstab.virtio (zramsize=50%, lz4) via the swapon_all trigger in /vendor/etc/init/zram.rc. Measured: lz4 compresses ~3x, the safe balloon cap drops 1536 -> 1024 MB, and a production (non-rooted) instance holds Roblox at that cap with zero kills. base_arm_system_zram.qcow2 is a ~1 MB COW overlay of base_arm_system.qcow2, which is untouched - revert by pointing 'system' back at it. (2026-08-05) NOTE: zstd was tried on top of this (v4) and REVERTED - it is worse. At the 896 MB cap lz4 holds with zero kills, zstd killed the game with 3 mem-pressure kills, and boot went 0.8 min -> 5+ min (timing out `omnidroid start`). zstd wins on compression RATIO but loses on THROUGHPUT, and on one vCPU it is reclaim LATENCY that decides whether an instance survives pressure. Do not retry without more vCPUs.

notes: Base images are immutable once any account references them. They live in the external data dir (images_dir; Windows C:/Users/berat/OmniImages, Linux/macOS ~/OmniImages) and are NEVER committed. Inside it images are CLASSIFIED BY ARCH: images_dir/arm/ and images_dir/x86/ -- the subfolder is part of every recorded filename here, and an offset always sits in the same folder as the /data it overlays (a qcow2 backing reference resolves relative to the overlay's own directory). base_x86 + base_arm are the two canonical bases; the host architecture selects between them.
